verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence pack describes an AWS-provided capability to export all of a user's data in open formats and leave the platform. The closest items are a general-purpose CLI, the Cost Explorer API for querying cost data, and CloudFormation stack deletion. These are building blocks or adjacent features, not a documented full-data export, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
